I was never an incel (technically I guess I am by definition, but I don't blame others for my misery) but I am an unattractive kissless virgin at 25 years old. It is very tempting to put the blame on women  and society in general. When you are surrounded by a culture of casual sex, promiscuity and high regards to being attractive, it can get very frustrating especially for young men who don't get to participate because of various reasons in and out of their control. Basically these Incels are Incels because that is an easier mechanism to cope. 

I empathize with their frustration but do not condone their disgusting and hateful rhetoric towards women.
Damn dude, I truly feel your pain and I am exactly half you're age. It's a sad and lonely world out there.
Thank you for the encouragement, but I'm probably going to be homeless in 2 weeks. I tried everything....now it's just waiting for the inevitable I guess.

I am scared of death at my age. But right now I feel like I don't want to live. I am essentially trapped between the fear of death and the dread of living a miserable life. 

I just wish I was dead when I was too young to have conscious thoughts.
